title: For small spaces
text: For small spaces. The photo shows a lighter finish, which I was hoping for.  It is a teak finish and a few inches shorter than the ones made out of cedar or pine wood.  The dish rack is made well and sturdy.

product_metadata.title: Collapsible Bamboo Drying Dish Rack - 2 Tier Level Folding Dish Rack for Counter Top - Quick Dry - Wooden Wood Dish Drainer - Kitchen Drying Utensils & Dishes - Plates Bowls - Easy Clean - Foldable
features: FOLDING BAMBOO DISH RACK: Fold the dish rack to easily store when your dishes are done drying
DURABLE BAMBOO: Bamboo is easily renewable, so its an environmentally friendly material. Adds a natural touch to your kitchen
2-TIER DESIGN: The 2-tier design allows you dry plates on top and bowls on the bottom
SPACIOUS: Holds up to 13 plates on top and multiple mugs and bowls on the lower area
DIMENSIONS: Expanded Dimensions: 17.75-Inch L x 11.5-Inch W x 10-Inch H. Folded Dimensions: 17.75-Inch L x 17.75-Inch W x 1.75-Inch H. Weight: 2.5 lbs.
